sections.content:
119,850 people

were counted on the census as "business sales executives" in England and Wales in March 2021.

Business sales executives provide advice to existing and potential customers, and receive orders for specialist machinery, equipment, materials and other products or services that require technical knowledge.

How old are people who do this job?

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 25 to 29 years. Of the whole working population 11.1% were aged 25 to 29 years. For people working as "business sales executives", 18.1% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "business sales executives" was 16 to 19 years.

sections.title: The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 25 to 29 years
sections.footer: Source: Census 2021 from Office for National Statistics

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "business sales executives" included:

  • chemical scientists
  • actors, entertainers and presenters
  • buyers and procurement officers

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

More men than women had this job

Among people working as "business sales executives" there were more men than women (63.1% compared with 36.9%).

This means "business sales executives" had a different proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "business and public service associate professionals".

Men made up 63.1% and women made up 36.9% of "business sales executives"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women. This occupation was one of the jobs for which the proportion of men and women was closest to this overall picture.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "business sales executives" included:

  • assemblers and routine operatives (other)
  • textile process operatives
  • quality control and planning engineers

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

We can look at who worked as "business sales executives" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

Among those aged 50 years and older, we see there is a higher proportion of men with this occupation than women.

The percentage of men and women who are "business sales executives" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "business sales executives", 7.4% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had more people aged between 30 and 49 years compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (85.3% compared with 14.7%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (91.4%) than self-employed (8.6%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South East. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Leeds, this is in the region of the Yorkshire & Humberside.
